review_scope: Independent source, frozen-output, provenance and scalar-arithmetic review. No audit/probe rerun or estimator execution.

findings: The stated frozen commit exists. Audit script, every hashed evidence input, both plans and the layout probe match that commit.
Both recorded execution statuses succeed. The saved layout binary matches its recorded SHA256; it was not executed by this reviewer.
Production src/include and the original bounded001/002, M1 and M1-belief-audit artifacts have no diff from the preceding921b19d9 checkpoint.
The audit reads saved query/scoring outputs and source text. Its restricted AST decoder does not import or execute the truth-bearing generator, create raw data, or replay model trajectories.
Public split arithmetic is computed from public source constants before scoring truth is loaded. Retrospective truth use remains separate.

public_split_review.interpretation: The fixed split preserves public log-state first two moments to the recorded floating precision. It does not preserve the original Gaussian density or provide hard support. Component exp(logQ mean) values are points, not physical-space posterior expectations. No filtering accuracy was tested.

frozen_failure_evidence_review.capacity_error_and_local_precision_arith: All twelve reported selected-query capacity errors and local half-widths agree with scalar formulas applied to the saved values.
frozen_failure_evidence_review.interpretation: Large opposing state contributions coexist with a small terminal-voltage difference. This supports endpoint compensation as an observed symptom. It does not identify a unique causal mechanism, prove a competing accurate basin, or show that a two-component capacity split will repair the error.
frozen_failure_evidence_review.reference_limit: The M1 reference was also unresolved at900s, with capacity error+26.629799869520767%. Its later successful fits do not prove that this new bounded candidate can meet the900s timely-learning gate. Candidate failure there is not physical-unidentifiability evidence.

input_only_bound_review.premises: Inherited static matched model, h in[-1,1], public gamma support, and the prescribed positive-current tail from1500s. No scoring truth enters this bound.
input_only_bound_review.interpretation: The arithmetic is consistent and identifies a conditional history-consistency violation of the saved point under the stated input/model premises.
input_only_bound_review.limits: The calculation uses the public exact event prescription and ordinary double/libm; it is not a fresh raw-input compliance audit or outward-rounded C certificate. The final broad bound trims only about0.0126 in h and does not exclude the full wrong SOC/Q/h compensation family or establish a sufficient capacity remedy.

resource_review.interpretation: The recorded host sizeof results and sums match the explicit proposed ownership. The probe implements no filter and measures no target deadline, live estimator peak, software-math stack or acquisition/persistence timing.
resource_review.qualification: Complete Cortex-M23 memory and35Hz timing remain unqualified. The2048B combined stack/runtime allowance and other target reserves are allocations, not measured sufficient costs.208B headroom is small; any measured reserve or total-cap excess must remain a failure.
resource_review.codec_limit: 3004B is the planned named-field serialized size. No codec was executed. It is not an additional full RAM buffer unless the implementation actually allocates one.

plan_consistency_review.mechanism: Exactly two persistent public logQ-split alternatives versus two coincident components; no pruning, rejuvenation, moment collapse back into inference or post-result starts/count sweep.
plan_consistency_review.accounting: Pre-correction scores update mixture weights while each conditional component assimilates once. Alternatives are summed; their posteriors or precision matrices are not multiplied.
plan_consistency_review.transaction: Complete staged-bank ownership, common physical chronology, distinct conditional/bank evidence cursors, weight-only learning, numerical rejection and atomic restore semantics are explicit.
plan_consistency_review.queries: Geometric capacity center, weighted SOC and component-voltage prediction are defined separately from moment-based local ranges/hulls and unresolved application qualification.
plan_consistency_review.future_gate: Freeze the implemented source, hashes, commands and resource receipt after the required targeted algebra, transaction and codec checks, before the planned two-arm31500-sample comparison.
plan_consistency_review.stop_rule: One B900 prefix comparison, then keep/reject/attribution-unresolved. No source integration, estimator run, longer horizon or full two-cell lifecycle primary occurred in this design audit.
plan_consistency_review.success_limit: A future useful point result can retain this mechanism for further qualification. It is not a coverage result, target qualification or proof that nonlinear-history loss has been repaired.

remaining_limits: The packed two-component learner, weighting transaction, query implementation and new codec are not implemented by this study.
Two components may share the same bias, miss the useful alternative or assign excessive predictive weight to a wrong branch.
Initial moment agreement and host ABI layout do not establish inference accuracy.
Endpoint compensation and the conditional h-bound violation do not establish hysteresis as the cause of capacity bias.
Complete target RAM, deadline, power-loss recovery, runtime longevity, physical model validity and uncertainty coverage remain open.
The design study ends at a frozen mechanism and falsification contract. No additional sweep or campaign is justified by these arithmetic checks.
